needs.a11y: Every utility and attribute is switched off under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, with content left visible and in place. The `:hover` lift only applies on devices that hover, so hover never sticks after a tap; `:focus-within` lift stays until blur. Put `hover-lift` on the bordered host (`Card`/`Surface`) — a borderless wrapper never paints the primary-tinted border. `hover-lift` uses the same lift, shadow and primary-tinted border on `:hover`, `:focus-visible` and `:focus-within`; reduced motion keeps the border and shadow and kills the translate.
needs.troubleshooting: Nothing animates — check the OS reduced-motion setting first. Content stays hidden — `data-reveal="pending"` and `data-stagger="pending"` hide content until your code sets them to `"in"`. Stagger has no delay — `stagger-*` delays an animation class (`animate-fade-up stagger-2`), not a transition. Parallax travel follows `--zk-motion-intensity` (default 1, `0` = no shift) times `--zk-motion-mobile` (`0.5` under 40rem); override on a subtree (`.hero { --zk-motion-intensity: 0.3 }`), not as an identity token. Derived amplitude is `min(calc(var(--zk-reveal-distance) * 8), var(--zk-parallax-max-shift, 120px))` (x-axis cap `12vw`). Sticky offset is `--zk-pin-top` (`calc(var(--zk-header-height) + 1rem)`).

needs.a11y: `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` leaves content visible and in place. Hover is gated to hover-capable pointers. Focus uses `:focus-visible`. Press ignores disabled. Longpress is decorative, never the only action. Appear does not set `aria-hidden`. Stagger-pending children are `visibility: hidden` (out of the tab order) until `in`.
needs.troubleshooting: Nothing appears to move — mount `<AnimateObserver />` once near the app root (or call `observeAnimate()`), then check reduced motion and `data-motion` on `<html>`. Content stays visible without JS by design. Scroll parallax needs `animation-timeline: view()` or the runtime fallback. In-app reduce flashes on load — render `<MotionScript />` in `<head>` (same pattern as `IdentityScript`) so `data-motion="reduce"` is set before paint; `useMotionPreference()` is `"reduce"` on the server.

Pinning stops inside a box — a parent with `overflow: hidden` or `auto` becomes the scroll container; keep the component in the normal page flow. needs.a11y: `IdentitySwitcher` is a native labelled `select` (visible label with `showLabel`, otherwise screen-reader only); `IdentityPicker` is a 44px trigger opening a sheet with a labelled radio group. Both render nothing when there is no identity to choose. While a custom sheet is active they show `Custom` (`CUSTOM_IDENTITY_ID`); a named look (`n-acme`) that is not in `identities` still appears as a selected option (label is the slug after `n-`) so the control never has a value missing from the list. Pass saved looks in `identities` to show their real labels. Picking a built-in look parks the custom sheet — it stays stored, scoped to its look, until `discardCustomIdentity` drops it. A choice applies at once and the new look keeps the kit's contrast pairs in light and dark; announce the change in your own status line (`role="status"`) if you show one. Keep the trigger name stable (`label`), because the current identity is read from the value.
needs.troubleshooting: The look flashes on load — render `<IdentityScript />` inside `<head>` with the same ids and storage key as the switcher, and `suppressHydrationWarning` on `<html>`. A stored id is ignored — it must be in `ids`. A stored custom sheet (`IDENTITY_CUSTOM_STORAGE_KEY`) wins over a built-in id. Built-in ids: `mist`, `press`, `tide`, `volt`, `maison`, `glass`; pass your own list to the script and the switcher to offer other looks. The whole page changed but you wanted one card — wrap it in `<ThemeScope identity="…" className="dark">` (or put `data-identity-scope` and `data-identity` on that node and add `.dark` on the same node). Dark tokens apply only when `.dark` is on the identity node, not on an ancestor. Dropdown panels (select, menu, popover, tooltip) portal into the nearest ThemeScope so they keep that identity and mode; dialog/drawer portals mount on `document.body` with a look-mirroring twin; without a scope they still mount on `document.body`. Two switchers disagree — give them the same `storageKey`; they follow each other through `IDENTITY_CHANGE_EVENT`. Switching looks parks a custom sheet (it is scoped to one look); call `discardCustomIdentity` to drop it for good.
